title: Coinbase gets full U.S. trust charter from federal banking regulator
reason: Major regulatory milestone for the largest US exchange, elevating status to full federal charter.

sources.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency elevated the biggest U.S. exchange's trust status from conditional to a full-fledged charter, the company said.

title: Zcash developers want 20-second blocks just days after major speed upgrade
reason: Significant protocol change proposal for a major PoW coin, backed by early performance data.

sources.summary: Early data shows Zcash's orphan-block rate holding close to pre-upgrade levels despite blocks arriving three times faster, encouraging developers to push for another reduction.
